name: IGDB
author: EverythingBox
description: Game artwork & metadata provider (IGDB). Aggregated with other providers on hover. Works out of the box; your own free Twitch developer credentials are optional.

settings.label: Twitch Client ID (optional)
settings.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the built-in credentials. To use your own, create a free app at https://dev.twitch.tv/console/apps to get a Client ID.

settings.label: Twitch Client Secret (optional)
settings.description: Optional. The Client Secret from your Twitch developer app.
